memory_candidates.content: When cleaning up references to a deleted file in a .claude/ system with core extension mirrors, check these additional locations beyond the primary context dir: extensions/core/index-entries.json, extensions/core/context/README.md, and any *-revision-guide.md or README files that list example filenames. Run `grep -rn <filename> .claude/context/ .claude/extensions/` after deletion to catch all references.
